explicit_revision_list.change: Replace 积分区域/积分子集 with 指定子集形成的区域/指定子集 J_izc.
explicit_revision_list.reason: P.integral c is a supplied Set, not an integration construction.

explicit_revision_list.change: Replace hull placeholders with 包络区域/包络系统 and name the least selected region 最小包络区域.
explicit_revision_list.reason: Apply user-finalized 包络, retaining the exact componentwise-unit and least-in-subclass definitions.

explicit_revision_list.change: Replace ハル with 正則包; region 正則包領域 and system 正則包系. Replace 整領域/整部分集合 by explicit supplied-subset wording.
explicit_revision_list.reason: Apply supplied verified base term and contextual derivatives; avoid interpreting 整領域 as an integral domain.

explicit_revision_list.change: Explain integralRegion as the region formed from the supplied subsets; replace finite integral subsets with supplied subsets at finite places.
explicit_revision_list.reason: The former finite wording could imply that the subsets themselves are finite; only the place was finite.

explicit_revision_list.change: Explicitly state that J_izc is a supplied subset of S_izc, with the supplied commutative-ring structure on S_izc.
explicit_revision_list.reason: Preserve the actual carrier and field type without adding a subring or ring-of-integers assumption.

explicit_revision_list.change: Use positive integer q-order instead of positive integral q-order.
explicit_revision_list.reason: Clarify the natural-number value; no mathematical change.

changes.before: positive integral q-order
changes.after: positive integer q-order

changes.before: The integral region is J_iz=product over c of J_izc.
changes.after: The specified subsets form the region J_iz=product over c of J_izc, called integralRegion in the code. Each J_izc is only a supplied subset of S_izc; the supplied commutative-ring structure is on S_izc.

changes.before: Component volumes vanish on the finite integral subsets and on specified infinite balls;
changes.after: At finite places the component volumes vanish on the supplied subsets J_izc, and at infinity they vanish on specified balls;

changes.before: a unit multiple of an integral subset
changes.after: a unit multiple of the supplied subset J_izc

changes.before: 积分区域 J_iz=product_c J_izc；
changes.after: 指定子集形成的区域为 J_iz=product_c J_izc，代码将其命名为 integralRegion；这里每个 J_izc 仅为 S_izc 的指定子集，给定的交换环结构在 S_izc 上。
